SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    ds.StoreName,
    s.total_sales,
    percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales) AS sales_percentile_rank
FROM
(
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY StoreKey
) AS s
LEFT JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds
    ON s.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC
